zh: 够发 {n} 条当年 140 字的微博
en: Enough for {n} classic 140-character Weibo posts
note: 1 Chinese character = 1 token, so the old 140-character Weibo limit is 140 tokens.

zh: 相当于把《心经》抄了 {n} 遍
en: Like copying the Heart Sutra {n} times
note: Xuanzang's Chinese Heart Sutra is 260 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 够你默写《兰亭集序》{n} 遍
en: Enough to write out the Lantingji Xu {n} times
note: The Lantingji Xu runs 324 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《千字文》从头背 {n} 遍
en: Like reciting the Thousand Character Classic {n} times
note: The Thousand Character Classic is exactly 1,000 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 等于把《道德经》读了 {n} 遍
en: Like reading the Tao Te Ching {n} times
note: The Peking University Han bamboo-slip Laozi has about 5,300 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 够把《新华字典》里每个字都过 {n} 遍
en: Like going through every character in the Xinhua Dictionary {n} times
note: The 12th edition of the Xinhua Dictionary has 13,000+ single characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《论语》读了 {n} 遍
en: Like reading the Analects {n} times
note: The Analects body text is 15,926 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 把《康熙字典》四万七千多个字头全扫一遍，能扫 {n} 轮
en: Like scanning all 47,043 entries in the Kangxi Dictionary {n} times
note: The Kangxi Dictionary lists 47,043 head characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《史记》读完 {n} 遍
en: Like reading Sima Qian's Records of the Grand Historian {n} times
note: The Shiji is about 526,500 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 够把《西游记》从头到尾读 {n} 遍
en: Like reading Journey to the West {n} times
note: The 100-chapter Shidetang edition is about 585,000 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《三国演义》读了 {n} 遍

note: The People's Literature Publishing House edition is 617,205 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《三体》三部曲读了 {n} 遍
en: Like reading the Three-Body trilogy {n} times
note: Liu Cixin's trilogy totals about 900,000 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 够把《红楼梦》读 {n} 遍，连判词都不跳过
en: Like reading Dream of the Red Chamber {n} times, poems and all
note: The People's Literature Publishing House edition is 1,089,335 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把《本草纲目》190 万字翻 {n} 遍

zh: 够把《资治通鉴》从头读到尾 {n} 遍
en: Like reading the Zizhi Tongjian cover to cover {n} times
note: The Zizhi Tongjian is about 3 million characters in 294 rolls; 1 character = 1 token.

zh: 相当于把金庸全集 36 册读 {n} 遍
en: Like reading all 36 volumes of Jin Yong's collected works {n} times
note: The 36-volume Jin Yong collection is 8,897,407 characters; 1 character = 1 token.

en: Enough to fill {n} printed book pages (250 words each)
note: 1 token = 0.75 English words: a 250-word page is 333 tokens.

en: Like writing {n} average Wikipedia articles
